North first-year value:
- Taxable cash = 185,000 + 0% bonus = 185,000
- After-tax cash = 185,000 * (1-0.25) = 138,750
- Retirement match = min(5% * 185,000, 20,000) = min(9,250, 20,000) = 9,250
- Equity vested by month 12 = 80,000 * 1/4 with 1-year cliff = 20,000
- Total = 138,750 + 9,250 + 20,000 = 168,000

South first-year value:
- Taxable cash = 170,000 + 0% bonus = 170,000
- After-tax cash = 170,000 * (1-0.25) = 127,500
- Retirement match = min(6% * 170,000, 9,000) = min(10,200, 9,000) = 9,000
- Equity vested by month 12 = 0 * 1/4 = 0
- Total = 127,500 + 9,000 + 0 = 136,500

168,000 > 136,500, so North is higher.
